reason: A conversational Excel plugin for reading, analyzing, editing, validating, repairing, and rolling back XLSX workbooks, with optional multi-step agent workflows and Windows Excel chart or pivot-table operations.

summaries.zh: 通过自然语言读取、分析、编辑、验证、修复和回滚 Excel 工作簿，并支持部分 Windows Excel 图表与透视表操作。
summaries.en: Use natural language to read, analyze, edit, validate, repair, and roll back Excel workbooks, with selected chart and pivot-table operations supported through Windows Excel.

capabilities: Writes and modifies workbook values, formulas, formatting, tables, filters, and charts
Validates, repairs, diffs, and rolls back workbook changes
Executes multi-step spreadsheet workflows from natural-language instructions
Can optionally use DeepSeek or visual language model services for formula repair and chart review
Can invoke local Microsoft Excel through Windows COM for selected chart and pivot-table operations
